name: Jodhpur (JBSL city e-buses, PM e-Bus Sewa)

source.name: Katch city bus tracking (katchapp.in/bus_tracking): the cities' published route maps (KML) and live GPS, built into GTFS by reclaim.city
source.detail: Unofficial: the PM e-Bus Sewa city operators publish no GTFS. Routes, stops in order and route lines from the route maps (KML) each city publishes on Katch's tracking pages (katch_bus/network_eb.py); departures from the buses seen starting each route on the live tracking, later stops timed from the median running times seen (timepoint=0); routes with no departure seen yet are listed without a timetable (katch_bus/gtfs_katch.py).

note: Unofficial: built from the city's published route maps and live GPS; times after the first stop are estimates (timepoint=0).

name: GSRTC intercity (Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation)

source.name: GSRTC public booking timetables (gsrtc.in OPRS), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (gsrtc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: GSRTC publishes no open GTFS. Routes are the state intercity corridors returned by the public booking site's from/to search (origin, the via towns, destination, by place code), towns geocoded (built-in gazetteer, else Nominatim) and joined by OSRM's road; departures and classes from the same search. Schedule only - no live positions (the live app is device-attestation gated). Stop times are OSRM driving time from the origin (timepoint=0). Read Nov 2026.

name: BSRTC (Bihar State Road Transport Corporation)

source.name: BSRTC depot timetables (bsrtc.co.in/schedules, one PDF per depot), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (bsrtc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: BSRTC publishes no open GTFS. Every service in the 12 depot timetable PDFs linked from the official Schedule page (origin, destination, departure, and where given BSRTC's service id and bus type); towns geocoded (built-in gazetteer, else Nominatim) and joined by OSRM's road. The PDFs give no via stops or arrival times, so each trip is origin to destination and the arrival is an estimate from OSRM driving time (timepoint=0). Schedule only, no live positions. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: origin and destination only, as published; arrival times are estimates (timepoint=0).

name: ASTC (Assam State Transport Corporation)

source.name: ASTC division timetables (astcbus.in/schedules, one PDF per division), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (astc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: ASTC publishes no open GTFS. Every service in the 9 division timetable PDFs linked from ASTC's Schedules page, each a list of stations with km, arrival and departure. Clock typos in the PDFs (AM/PM slips, a departure before its arrival) are repaired against the timetable km. Towns geocoded (built-in gazetteer for the trunk towns and Guwahati's terminals, else Nominatim checked against the timetable km; villages it does not know are placed on the road at their km) and joined by OSRM's road. Stop times are the PDFs' own (timepoint=1; halts listed without a time are interpolated, timepoint=0). Every service runs daily (the PDFs give no day pattern). Schedule only, no live positions. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: the PDFs' own times; stop positions are town or stand level (some villages approximate, on the road at their timetable km).

name: SNT (Sikkim Nationalised Transport)

source.name: Sikkim Transport Department's published bus schedule and SNT's fare notification (Sikkim Government Gazette No. 325, 24 Jun 2024), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (sikkim_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: SNT publishes no GTFS. Departures (time, bus type) from the Transport Department's Bus Schedule page: SNT's services between Siliguri and Gangtok (Ordinary and A/C), Namchi, Jorethang and Pelling. Halts and fares from SNT's fare notification (Gazette No. 325, Annexure-A): the Gangtok buses stop at its fare stages Ranipool, Singtam, Rangpo and Melli (timed in proportion to its km), and fares are its stage fares by zone (fare_rules by route, origin and destination); the page's fares all equal the gazette's. Arrivals use SNT's own published journey times (timepoint=0). Stands from OpenStreetMap, joined by OSRM's road. Schedule only, no live positions. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: inter-state services to and from Siliguri only; Namchi, Jorethang and Pelling services are ends only, as published; times past the first stop are estimates (timepoint=0).

name: TNSTC + SETC intercity (Tamil Nadu state transport)

source.name: TNSTC / SETC public booking timetables (tnstc.in OTRSOnline), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (tnstc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: TNSTC and SETC publish no open GTFS. Trips are the reserved services the public booking site's from/to search returns between 53 hub towns for one weekday (place catalog LoadFromPlaceList, availability SearchService; no auth), one agency per corporation (SETC and the six TNSTC regional corporations). Each trip's towns are its origin (trip code), the hub towns it was searched at (with their times), its via towns and its terminus (start plus journey hours); towns geocoded (built-in gazetteer, else Nominatim) and joined by OSRM's road. Observed times are timepoints; towns between them are interpolated by driving time (timepoint=0). Daily calendar. Schedule only: there is no public live tracking. Only reserved services are on the booking site, not short unreserved town services. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: built from the TNSTC/SETC public booking timetables; stops are towns and bus stands, times between the searched hub towns are estimates (timepoint=0).

name: MSRTC (Maharashtra State Road Transport Corporation)

source.name: MSRTC bus-stand timetable boards (msrtc.maharashtra.gov.in Timetable PDFs), read by OCR and built into GTFS by reclaim.city (msrtc_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: MSRTC publishes no open GTFS. Its Timetable page links one PDF per division (31 divisions, 614 pages); every page is an image of a bus stand's departure board in Marathi (outgoing times, destination, incoming times). Read by OCR (OpenCV table cells, Tesseract Marathi): 319 pages were legible (the rest are photographs of painted boards too small to read), giving 20,624 departures; destination and stand names matched to OpenStreetMap places (name:mr, else transliteration weighted by distance from the stand), 13,906 placed. One trip per departure on each stand -> destination corridor, both ends a town or its OSM bus station, joined by OSRM's road; times after the first stop are OSRM driving time x 1.3 (timepoint=0). Daily calendar. OCR can misread an odd time or town. Schedule only: MSRTC's vehicle tracking is not open. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: read by OCR from MSRTC's published bus-stand timetable boards; stops are towns and bus stands, times after the first are estimates (timepoint=0), and an odd time or town may be misread.

name: PRTC (PEPSU Road Transport Corporation)

source.name: PRTC online booking timetable (pepsuonline.com), built into GTFS by reclaim.city (pepsu_bus)
source.detail: Unofficial: PRTC publishes no open GTFS. Every trip sold online on pepsuonline.com for one weekday (Tue 24 Nov 2026), from the site's public town catalog and from/to search (no auth): every bookable pair in the site's catalog (173). A trip searched between several pairs of its towns gives the operator's time at each, so trips are ordered runs of towns with published times (timepoint=1). Towns are bus stands / town centres (OSM gazetteer + overrides), joined by OSRM's road. Only online-sold trips (almost all AC / Volvo): ordinary buses are not sold online and are absent. Schedule only, no live positions. Read Nov 2026.

note: Unofficial: online-sold trips only (mostly AC / Volvo), times as published at each town; ordinary buses absent.
